comment: Reboot gate for the S10+ (beyond2lte), installed to /etc/nuxel/buttons/reboot-gate.json. This is the ONLY thing that decides whether a very-long power press or the power-menu Restart/Power-off entry may actually act. It is OPEN because the owner explicitly requested a working power menu and every visible option must be functional. The cooldown is a short 10 s debounce (not a 30 min lockout), the hourly cap prevents a reboot loop, and the rollback-path requirement remains. Only a userspace `systemctl --no-block reboot|poweroff` is ever executed.

policy_source_contract.comment: bg-09 owns the reboot policy. When this file exists and carries allow_reboot: true, the gate treats it as an additional permission (AND, not OR, with this file's own flags) so neither group can silently override the other.

refusal_reason: owner present and explicitly requested a working power menu

execution.comment: Only a userspace reboot path is ever used. Nothing here talks to a bootloader, a partition or a block device.

state_file_comment: Epoch seconds of the last gated reboot/power-off. It lives in its own directory: the manager state document is /var/lib/nuxel/buttons (a FILE), so a path below it could never be created and the cooldown record was silently lost.
